page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left. Below it, a grammar table of Greek verb forms in several columns: a Latin headword at the left, then Greek forms in two or three columns, with mood headings centred between the blocks. Lower left, a short Latin column of the headword list. "PAR-" at the bottom right as a catchword.

page.notes: The Greek forms are copied from the scan with difficulty; the accents and breathings in several places are uncertain and may differ from the printer's exact marks. Marginal column on the far left and right edges contains no legible printed notes. The Latin words "Si inaure." and "Inaurare." are headword labels, not notes. The catchword "PAR-" is at the bottom right.
